glosses: to fall hopelessly in love; to be infatuated (de (“with”))

examples.text: La vie est dure, pauvre et malheureuse mais l'existence de cette Afrique-là qui vivote, survit, s'amourache, s'encanaille, se volatilise est indéniable.
examples.translation: Life is tough, poor, and miserable, but the existence of that Africa which struggles to get by, survives, falls in love, rubs elbows with the common people, [and] vanishes into thin air is undeniable.
examples.english: Life is tough, poor, and miserable, but the existence of that Africa which struggles to get by, survives, falls in love, rubs elbows with the common people, [and] vanishes into thin air is undeniable.

glosses: Engager dans un amour peu justifié.

examples.text: Alors Nozdriov étala devant eux ses pipes en bois, en terre, en écume […], une blague brodée par une comtesse, qui s’était amourachée de lui dans un relai.
Moi je suis trop Normande pour m’amouracher de tout ce qui vient de l’étranger, et surtout de l’Angleterre.
Sapho qui aime les cheveux frisés, s’amourache de Gaussin, garçon insipide et nul.
Un homme de trente ans, dans cette situation, aller s’amouracher d’une fille si jeune qui n’avait que la malice en tête ! Il ne pensait pas, peut-être, mener l’aventure au bout ?
Quand on est d’une famille de travailleurs modestes, on s’amourache pas d’une demoiselle qui sait même pas faire la cuisine !

glosses: To suddenly begin to feel romantic attraction (towards).

examples.text: The deal was that if anyone started catching feelings, he could throw up a stop sign and the other would honor it.

glosses: To come to have feelings of love, particularly romantic love.

examples.text: I fell in love with him the moment I first saw him.
Have you ever fallen in love?
It only takes a minute girl / To fall in love
Oh, Ophelia / You've been on my mind, girl, since the flood / Oh, Ophelia / Heaven help a fool who falls in love
Often, I am upset / That I cannot fall in love, but I guess / This avoids the stress of falling out of it

It's been a long time since you fell in love / You ain't coming out your shell, you ain't really been yourself / Tell me, what must I do? (Do tell, my love) / 'Cause luckily I'm good at reading / I wouldn't bug him, but he won't stop cheesin'

glosses: To come to have feelings of love towards each other.

examples.text: They met, fell in love, got married, and lived happily ever after.

'Cause we were just kids when we fell in love
Not knowing what it was
I will not give you up this time.

glosses: To come to have feelings of intense liking directed at another person or a thing.

examples.text: I have just fallen in love with Rome!

無可救藥地墜入愛河（de (“和……”)）

examples.text: La vie est dure, pauvre et malheureuse mais l'existence de cette Afrique-là qui vivote, survit, s'amourache, s'encanaille, se volatilise est indéniable.
examples.translation: 生活艱苦、貧窮而悲慘，但那個掙扎求存、生存、墜入愛河、與普通人交往、消失得無影無蹤的非洲的存在是不可否認的。
